title: File Organization for Coursework
description: CAT 100 textbook section connecting file organization for coursework to coursework file organization plan, reader notes, support moments, and revision evidence.
learning_objectives: Build a course/module/task folder tree so all files for one assignment travel together.
Apply a `date_course_task_version` naming pattern that makes the newest file obvious at a glance.
Keep a second synced copy so a single device failure never destroys the only version of your work.
Justify each filing decision by the question it answers for a future reader: which file, which version, where.
